this_court: Section 115(a)(1)(B) reaches all individuals covered by 18 U.S.C. § 1114, including persons assisting federal officers, and is not limited to § 1114 'officials.'
quote: And it is telling that the dissent cites no case that has reached a different conclusion regarding the interplay between §§ 115 and 1114.
cite: United States v. Jacqueline Anderson, 46 F.4th 1000 (9th Cir. 2022)
